obligations.description: At a rising edge E, latch read enable, index and tag unconditionally from current f1 inputs. At edge E+1 register each way response from the row selected by the latched index, using row state immediately before E+1 writes. Thus a row write at E is visible to that read, while a write at E+1 is not. With the latched read enable high, response valid is stored entry valid AND matching7-bit tag AND not sweeping at E+1; counter is the row3-bit counter and usefulness is {high,low}, even on a tag miss or invalid entry. With latched enable low, counter/usefulness are unknown and valid is unknown unless sweeping forces it low; do not assume zero or held response. Response registers and read pipeline are not synchronously cleared by reset itself. Every cycle can launch a new read.

obligations.description: After sweep, increment the unsigned19-bit age each clock modulo2^19. When pre-edge age bits10:0 are zero, clear all4 ways of one usefulness array at row age[17:11]. Sweep has higher priority; normal masked usefulness writes to the array being cleared lose that edge, while the other array may still update.
